text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto watches the Derby of the 
generation above her alongside T.M. Opera 
O.

Victory went to Special Week. With such a 
powerhouse lineup of fellow Umamusume, 
they truly earned their title as the 
"Golden Generation"...

In contrast, Meisho Doto panics over her 
own lack of ability, but...

Snapping awake after being scolded by TM 
Opera O, she fires herself up with an 
extraordinary level of motivation for the 
Debut Race.
